Additional Rezk Segal-space infrastructure for the diagonal criterion, not a literal claim of the ancestor paragraph. Supporting lemma: Homotopy fibers of equifibered diagrams of Kan fibrations survive the diagonal.

title: Homotopy fibers of equifibered diagrams of Kan fibrations survive the diagonal
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, Kan complexes, homotopy fibers and weak homotopy equivalences from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the Kan model structure of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Let $X_\bullet,Y_\bullet:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$ be small simplicial diagrams of Kan complexes, and let $p:X_\bullet\to Y_\bullet$ be a natural transformation such that every $p_m:X_m\to Y_m$ is a Kan fibration. Suppose that for every $\alpha:[m]\to[n]$ in $\Delta$ the naturality square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}X_n&\xrightarrow{X(\alpha)}&X_m\\ p_n\downarrow&&\downarrow p_m\\ Y_n&\xrightarrow{Y(\alpha)}&Y_m\end{array}$$
is a homotopy pullback. For $Z=X,Y$ put $(\operatorname{diag}Z)_q=(Z_q)_q$ with both operators applied simultaneously. The unique maps $[m]\to[0]$ induce maps from the constant diagrams on $X_0,Y_0$, hence maps $\iota_X:X_0\to\operatorname{diag}X$ and $\iota_Y:Y_0\to\operatorname{diag}Y$. Then
$$\begin{array}{ccc}X_0&\xrightarrow{\iota_X}&\operatorname{diag}X\\ p_0\downarrow&&\downarrow\operatorname{diag}p\\ Y_0&\xrightarrow{\iota_Y}&\operatorname{diag}Y\end{array}$$
is a homotopy pullback, naturally in $p$. Equivalently, for each vertex $y\in Y_0$, the canonical comparison from the strict fiber $p_0^{-1}(y)$ to the homotopy fiber of $\operatorname{diag}p$ at $\iota_Y(y)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. Homotopy pullbacks and homotopy fibers involving a non-Kan diagonal are computed after functorial Kan replacement of the corresponding diagram. No Reedy fibrancy of the diagrams or Kan condition on their diagonals is assumed.

source.place: Theorem 6.1 and Propositions 2.2, 2.7, specialized to simplicial sets, with Remark 6.8 for rowwise equivalences; printed pp. 3-4, 11-12. The row-zero comparison follows by pulling the diagram back along the constant diagram on Y_0. Also the realization-fiber argument in Rezk, A model for the homotopy theory of homotopy theory, Section 14, pp. 33-34. Read online; not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this result.

mathlib_searches.query: A map of bisimplicial sets whose every naturality square is a homotopy pullback has the same homotopy fibers after diagonal realization
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: Mathlib NatTrans.Equifibered requires strict pullback naturality squares in an ordinary category, and EquifiberedLimits concerns closure under limits, not homotopy fibers after bisimplicial diagonal realization. The remaining hits concern Kan fibrations, ordinary categorical squares, or paths of topological homotopies. Read Limits/Shapes/Pullback/Equifibered.lean:39-67 and EquifiberedLimits.lean:17-45; the focused AlgebraicTopology grep found no bisimplicial or homotopy-cartesian implementation.
